settings.name: Study range type
settings.description: Use LONG_RANGE for bird, marine, migratory, cross-UTM-zone, or uncertain study extents. It uses packaged Natural Earth land polygons and annotates Land (10) or Water (80). Use LOCAL only for a study known to be spatially local. It fetches detailed ESA WorldCover data through the Microsoft Planetary Computer: 10 Tree cover, 20 Shrubland, 30 Grassland, 40 Cropland, 50 Built-up, 60 Bare / sparse vegetation, 70 Snow and ice, 80 Permanent water bodies, 90 Herbaceous wetland, 95 Mangroves, 100 Moss and lichen.

settings.name: Add UTM conversion
settings.description: Whether to add per-animal UTM conversion. If checked, columns 'utm_x' and 'utm_y' are added per animal with their respective UTM codes

settings.name: Keep GeoTIFF files
settings.description: Provide all per-animal GeoTIFFs in one downloadable tiffs.zip artifact. LOCAL rasters are clipped ESA WorldCover data accessed through Planetary Computer; LONG_RANGE rasters are generated from packaged Natural Earth polygons. All rasters are reprojected to the local WGS 84 UTM zone used for processing.
